---
name: Review metadata proposal
about: Propose a target-bound review record; this does not appoint a reviewer or open public draft corpus intake.
---

Public metadata proposals only until draft/submission terms are approved. Do not paste questions, keys, source scans, uncertain-rights prose, private correspondence, email/contact details or credentials. Public GitHub activity and history are visible. Preferred public names or agreed pseudonyms are sufficient; no legal name/email is requested. This template grants no licence or review authority.

Reviewer public Agent UUID / exact Agent revision and preferred public name:

Review category / controlled reviewType / reviewerRole; appointment evidence if applicable:

Target content UUID / exact revision / SHA-256 and dependency pins:

Whole-record or field scope (JSON pointers); explicit boundaries:

Outcome: approved for stated scope / changes requested / rejected / disputed / unable to determine:

Disclosure-safe rationale and evidence refs:

Limitations / unresolved issues / conflicts of interest and required independent review:

Technical review is not Sanskrit, pedagogical or rights approval. A contributor cannot self-certify independent approval.
